title: cacalia beyrichii
intro: Cacalia beyrichii, commonly known as the "Bai Cao", is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Cacalia beyrichii is used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic actions, such as soothing digestive issues, treating fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Cacalia beyrichii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
